discordPostHtml:
I'm completely rewriting the mod from scratch, so the description below is no longer relevant. However, I've created a temporary mod based on another mod. Scroll all the way to the bottom.

~~||True Weapon Stats is a lightweight, pure Quality-of-Life utility that brings real, dynamically calculated weapon statistics directly into the Refit screen tooltips.

No more mental math when equipping hullmods or choosing weapons!

✨ Key Features:
  • Live Dynamic Tooltips: Hovering over any weapon dynamically displays the true effective stats in parentheses Base (Modified) with intuitive color highlighting:
    • Range: Factors in ITU / DTC, Ballistic Rangefinder, Advanced Optics, officer skills, and hull bonuses.
    • Damage & DPS: Real per-shot damage, sustained DPS, and RoF accounting for hullmods and skill multipliers.
    • Flux Stats: Real flux/sec, flux/shot, and flux/damage ratios.
    • Ammo & Reload: Expanded Magazines, missile racks, ammo regeneration rates, and missile HP bonuses.
  • Full Built-In & Integrated Weapon Support:

Unlike other tools, fully supports unique built-in weapons (e.g., Onslaught TPCs, Paragon lances, and modded built-in superweapons) directly queried from the live ship instance.

  • Instant Reactivity: Swap hullmods on the fly — weapon stats update immediately without closing or reopening the screen.
  • Refit Weapon Picker Preview: Browsing cargo weapons shows the projected range for the selected mount before you even equip it.
  • Corrected Ship Weapon Flux: Fixes the right-hand panel's weapon flux/sec readout to show the true sustained flux generation of all mounted weapons.
  • Multi-Language & Localization Ready: Language-agnostic data-matching architecture (works flawlessly on English, Russian, and localized game clients).||

~~
